# Altitude design system

> Lit 3 web components + React wrappers, monorepo, evolving via a gate-driven
> v2 refactor described in NEXT-GEN-UPGRADE-PLAN.md.

## Read first

- [Refactor plan](/NEXT-GEN-UPGRADE-PLAN.md): authoritative spec for every
  active task (T0.x through T6.x), guardrails (G1–G8), gates (P0–P6).
- [Agent contract](/AGENTS.md): authoring rules, where things live, how to
  verify changes.
- [Migration manifest](/.altitude/migration.json): per-component state.
  `legacy` components are read-only outside migration PRs (G2, CI-enforced).
- [Pinned targets](/.altitude/targets.json): committed end-state versions
  (React 19, Vite, SD v5, pnpm, Lit 3.3, Storybook 10).

## Subsystem docs

- [Token engine](/.altitude/TOKENS.md): SD v3 + v5 parallel pipeline,
  byte-comparable CSS output. Tokens are DTCG.
- [Build pipeline](/.altitude/BUILD.md): webpack + Vite parallel, with the
  SCSS-import rewrite plugin that bridges both.
- [Semver policy](/.altitude/SEMVER.md): semver + migration-state interaction.
- [Baselines](/.altitude/baselines/README.md): VRT screenshots, token snapshot,
  bundle size — the truth-set every change must move with (G8).

## Source of truth for consumers

- [Custom Elements Manifest](/libs/al-web-components/custom-elements.json):
  generated by `@custom-elements-manifest/analyzer`. Coverage gated by
  `scripts/check-cem-coverage.js`.
- [Token name union](/libs/al-web-components/dist/css/tokens.d.ts):
  TypeScript types for every `--al-*` name. Generated, not tracked in git —
  run `pnpm --filter al-web-components build:tokens` in a fresh clone. Ships in
  the published package; consumers import it as
  `al-web-components/tokens.d.ts`.
- [Frozen alias map](/libs/al-web-components/dist/css/aliases.json):
  identity map at T1.1; deprecation budget 3.0.0. Same generated-not-tracked
  rule as above; consumers import it as `al-web-components/aliases.json`.
- [Token values](/libs/al-web-components/dist/css/tokens.json): every resolved
  `--al-*` value. Generated, not tracked; consumers import it as
  `al-web-components/tokens.json`.
- [Token source](/libs/al-web-components/styles/tokens/): the tracked, hand-authored
  Tokens Studio tree the three generated artifacts above are built from. This is the
  path to read in a bare clone with no build; `styles/tokens-dtcg/` is its generated
  DTCG mirror and ships in the package as `al-web-components/tokens-dtcg/*`.

## Agent ground truth — the two digests

Tracked in git, so readable in a bare clone with no build. `AGENTS.md` cites these
whenever it says "the digest"; both are regenerated by
`pnpm --filter al-web-components build` and drift-gated by the `cem-and-contracts`
CI job.

- [Tokens digest](/.altitude/ai-readiness/tokens-digest.json): every `--al-*` name
  grouped by family, plus a `conventions` block — the real role/suffix matrix for
  the content/background/border colour families and a `notExistDoNotInvent` list of
  known hallucination targets. Verify every token name against this.
  Built by `scripts/ai-readiness/build-tokens-digest.mjs`.
- [CEM digest](/.altitude/ai-readiness/cem-digest.json): every tag with its
  attributes, slots, events and enum values, plus a per-tag `doNotFlag` array of
  sanctioned patterns a reviewer must not report as violations. Verify every tag /
  attribute / slot / event claim against this.
  Built by `scripts/ai-readiness/build-cem-digest.mjs`.

Both are mirrored to `/tmp/ai-readiness-tokens-digest.json` and
`/tmp/ai-readiness-cem-digest.json` — the paths the fleet probe
(`scripts/ai-readiness/run-probe.mjs`) and judge (`run-judge.mjs`) hand to agents.
`.altitude/ai-readiness/runs/` (probe output) is the only gitignored part.

## Pilot components (the 5 that prove every new pattern, G3)

- button (`libs/al-web-components/components/button/`)
- input (`libs/al-web-components/components/input/`)
- select (`libs/al-web-components/components/select/`)
- dialog (`libs/al-web-components/components/dialog/`)
- theme-switcher (`libs/al-web-components/components/theme-switcher/`)

## MCP server (T7.2)

- [`libs/altitude-mcp`](/libs/altitude-mcp/README.md): a stdio MCP server over the same
  generated contract surface listed above. Read-only; registered in `.mcp.json` as
  `altitude`. **Eight tools**, all covered by `libs/altitude-mcp/test/smoke.mjs` (CI job
  `mcp-smoke`, which asserts the count so a ninth tool cannot ship untested):
  `altitude_list_components`, `altitude_get_component`, `altitude_validate`,
  `altitude_get_tokens` (`brand` is an enum of the two shipped brands — `altitude`,
  `southleft`), `altitude_search_icons`, `altitude_generate_theme` (deterministic OKLCH,
  never an LLM call), `altitude_check_parity` (takes `project`) and
  `altitude_list_ds_projects`.
